old_problem: The row neither maps tuple0:0:3 to slot1~N nor names the access that consumes the implicit arm, making exactly-one-event and automatic-disarm behavior untestable.
disposition_reason: One-shot semantics require more than a runtime target: the supported arm state, consuming transaction and post-consumption disarm contract define the operation. The proprietary command exposes only a UMC tuple that may cover multiple slots. ED-16 prohibits guessing a trigger or repeatedly probing an armed injector. Until AMD supplies the selector/trigger state machine and safe negative check, this remains Pending/BLOCKED.

test_case.test_name: AMD implicit one-shot correctable DRAM injection per slot
test_case.purpose: For every required physical slot, prove the approved implicit mode arms, injects exactly one CE on a defined synthetic access and automatically disarms.
required_package: Synthetic target allocation and exact consuming access
Profile/tool semantics and per-slot CE counter/event oracle
Abort, residual-injector recovery and full restoration
test_case.test_command: Do not arm the source tuple. After AMD defines the state machine, select one mapped slot, capture arm status/counters, arm once, perform the exact synthetic consuming access, capture one attributable CE, repeat the verification access to prove no second injection, confirm disarm and restore before another target.
test_case.expected_result: Each approved slot shows one—and only one—correctable event after the documented trigger, no event on the negative second access, healthy memory and an inactive injector after restoration.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS exists until trigger and selector semantics are authoritative. Tool PASS at arm time, one generic CE, missing negative check, multiple events or uncertain disarm cannot pass.
safety_gate: Dedicated ECC SUT and synthetic owned allocation.
No arming until tuple/slot and exact trigger are signed.
Stop on wrong slot, repeated event, UCE, reset, poison or uncertain arm state.
Never probe by repeated injection or auto-retry.
expected_evidence: Arm plus first-trigger transcript and one CE delta
Second access with zero additional event and explicit disarm
test_case.recovery: The AMD owner must define how to query and forcibly clear a residual arm without generating another event. Until that emergency-disarm path is approved, the one-shot test cannot execute safely.
